findings.claim: Flexible ads configured with creative_asset_groups_spec on the Ad are misclassified as reusable static posts, silently dropping asset variants upon reuse.
findings.evidence: compilador.py writes creative_asset_groups_spec to /act_{account}/ads while providing a fallback object_story_spec on the creative (lines 752-765, 810-819). In posts_existentes.py, catalogo requests only creative fields without creative_asset_groups_spec (line 157), and normalize checks only creative.get('asset_feed_spec') (line 123). Flexible ads fall through to the static parser (line 128), returning is_flexible=False and reuse_supported=True with a single image hash and copy. Furthermore, deduplication (lines 172-176) preserves the first record's flags when multiple ads share a post_id. When reused, compilador.py skips META_FLEXIBLE_POST_REUSE_UNPROVEN and builds a static ad referencing object_story_id, dropping all non-fallback variants without operator awareness.
findings.proposal: Include creative_asset_groups_spec in catalogo fields params. In normalize, check row.get('creative_asset_groups_spec') and extract asset variants into flexible preview metadata (is_flexible=True, reuse_supported=False, preview_only=True). In catalogo deduplication, escalate is_flexible=True and reuse_supported=False if any referencing ad row contains flexible specifications.
findings.test: Hermetic unit test: pass an ad row with creative_asset_groups_spec (containing multiple image hashes) and fallback object_story_spec into normalize; assert is_flexible=True, reuse_supported=False, and image_variants matches group count. Verify compilador raises META_FLEXIBLE_POST_REUSE_UNPROVEN when reusing this post. Verify deduplicating a static row and a flexible row sharing one post_id results in reuse_supported=False.

findings.claim: Existing-post discovery discards valid ads and posts that omit optional link descriptions, breaking social-proof reuse and flexible text pool parity.
findings.evidence: Line 141 enforces if not all(fields.values()): return None, where fields includes description: str(link.get('description') or ''). In Meta's Marketing API, link description is an optional attribute on link_data. compilador.py explicitly removes description when absent from flexible text pools (lines 762-765), and contrato_v2.py allows descriptions to be omitted in flexible blueprints (line 720). Consequently, any valid ad created without a description is discarded (returns None) during discovery, preventing legitimate static posts from being discovered or reused for social proof.
findings.proposal: Update normalize to require only mandatory fields ('message', 'headline'), treating 'description' as optional with fallback to empty string. In _normalize_flexible (line 89), remove 'or not descriptions' from the disqualifying check and default to an empty string preview when descriptions are absent.
findings.test: Hermetic unit test: invoke normalize with an ad row whose object_story_spec.link_data contains valid message, name, link, image_hash, and call_to_action, but lacks description; assert normalize returns a valid dict with description='' and reuse_supported=True instead of None.

sources.claim: In Meta Marketing API, the flexible ad format defines multiple creative assets via creative_asset_groups_spec on the Ad object, rather than asset_feed_spec on the child AdCreative.

limitations: Fact: posts_existentes.py currently queries fields on creative without creative_asset_groups_spec on the ad row. Hypothesis: Provider ads created outside this system may continue using legacy dynamic creative via creative.asset_feed_spec, requiring both formats to be handled concurrently.

Fact: catalogo pagination breaks and raises META_EXISTING_POST_CATALOG_INCOMPLETE if cursors repeat or are absent while next exists. Hypothesis: Accounts exceeding 10,000 ads (100 iterations of limit 100) are intentionally blocked to avoid partial catalog states.
review.summary: Flexible ads created with creative_asset_groups_spec at the ad level are misclassified as reusable static posts because discovery checks only creative.asset_feed_spec, silently discarding variant assets upon post-ID reuse. In addition, requiring descriptions on all posts causes valid ads lacking optional descriptions to be dropped from discovery.
